job.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

VOLVO IT

We are looking for a full stack developer on the IoT domain with strong experience in microservices development with Kubernetes, Azure infrastructure, and .NET & React languages.  
The consultant will be part of an IoT team that develops, deploys, maintains, scales the Volvo global asset tracking platform. The consultant will bring expertise to the team to continue enhancing this IT platform with speed and quality.  
The goal is to provide a unique worldwide Volvo solution that ensures the tracking of logistics flows (parts, components, packaging...) with a high level of accuracy through IoT technologies such as BLE, GNSS, UWB and GPS.  
The main capabilities include onboarding a wide range of tracking hardware, performing position logic, alerting planners, making tracking data consumable by other products.

Within the DTO (Digital Technology & Operations) organization, the “IoT Adoption” team is the expert team for IoT platforms and solutions.  
We are an international team (Europe / India) and we manage:

* the exploration of future IoT use cases or capabilities

o Strong IT development skills to manage all phases of a software development life cycle with high-quality standards, including business analysis, development, testing, deployment, and follow-up.  
o Ability to think globally and contribute to the development of IoT practice guidelines

o Experience in development of asset tracking solutions in global industries

job.title: Java Fullstack with Angular 2+ @ UST (MH, IN)
job.description:
**Role description**

Job Title: Java Full Stack Senior Developer Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Java Full Stack Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, MicroservicesCloud technologies. The ideal candidate should be able to design, develop, test, and deploy scalable web applications, working across both backend and frontend components. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, experience building cloud-native applications, API integration, and familiarity with modern DevOps and CI/CD practices. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end applications using Java and Angular. Build scalable backend services and REST APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot. Design and develop applications using Microservices architecture. Develop responsive and reusable frontend components using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Design and integrate RESTful APIs between frontend, backend, and external systems. Develop, Test and deploy cloud-native applications. Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, exception handling, logging, and application security practices. Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases and implement efficient data-access solutions. Participate in application design, technical discussions, code reviews, and engineering decisions. Implement and support CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment. Use containerization technologies such as Docker and work with orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes, where applicable. Troubleshoot application, integration, and performance issues across frontend, backend, and cloud environments. Collaborate with Product, UX, QA, DevOps, Architecture, and other engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Follow software engineering best practices for code quality, security, maintainability, scalability, and performance. Leverage GenAI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Kiro, or equivalent AI coding assistants to improve developer productivity and accelerate software delivery. Use GenAI tools responsibly across the development lifecycle for code generation, refactoring, unit testing, testing, debugging, documentation, and technical analysis. Apply appropriate engineering review, security, and coding standards when using AI-generated code. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 5 to 7 years of full stack development experience in Java and Angular tech stack Backend Development Strong hands-on experience with Java. Strong experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot. Experience developing RESTful APIs and Microservices. Experience with Hibernate/JPA and database integration. Good understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, exception handling, and application security. Frontend Development Strong hands-on experience with Angular and TypeScript. Good knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web development. Experience with component-based frontend architecture and state-management concepts. Experience integrating Angular applications with REST APIs. Microservices & Integration Hands-on experience designing and developing Microservices-based applications. Understanding of API design, service-to-service communication, authentication, logging, monitoring, and error handling. Familiarity with asynchronous processing, messaging, or event-driven architecture is desirable. Testing Awareness of functional testing, test strategy, test planning Self-test the implemented functionality leveraging automated testing tools to deliver the quality feature. GenAI-Assisted Software Development Hands-on experience using GenAI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Kiro, or similar tools in day-to-day software development. Ability to effectively use AI-assisted development for Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Microservices, testing, and documentation. Good understanding of responsible AI-assisted development practices, including code review, security, quality validation, and protection of sensitive information. Good to Have Experience with Apigee or other API management/gateway platforms. Experience with Amazon Connect / IVR integrations. Exposure to Salesforce integrations. Experience working with legacy frontend technologies such as GWT. Experience with Redux or other state-management approaches. Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS messaging services. Knowledge of automated testing frameworks for backend and frontend applications. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical problems. Good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Strong ownership and accountability for assigned deliverables. Ability to guide junior developers and contribute to technical discussions and code reviews. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Primary Technology Stack Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | REST APIs | Angular | TypeScript | AWS/Azure/GCP | SQL/NoSQL | Git | CI/CD | Docker | Kubernetes | GenAI tool | Agentic AI

 **Skills**

Angular, Java, Spring Boot, SQL, Agile, Microservices, JavaScript, Hibernate, Authentication and Authorization, CI/CD, Generative AI

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

job.title: Technical Manager @ Trane Technologies (TN, IN)
job.description:
Location Chennai, Tamil Nādu, India Category Information Technology Job Id JR-19457 Corporate

  

Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

  
  

Learn about our benefits designed for you to thrive at work and at home.

  
  

We boldly go.

  
  

**Where is the work:**

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.  

**What's in it for you:**

Join the CHVAC Embedded Controls team in Chennai and help build next-generation embedded control systems and connected cloud applications. As a Technical Manager — Full Stack Developer, you will lead the design and delivery of software spanning embedded Linux controllers, real-time communication protocols, modern web interfaces, and AWS cloud services. You'll combine hands-on technical leadership with people and delivery management — mentoring engineers while staying close to the code. This is a role for a seasoned full-stack technologist who thrives at the intersection of low-level embedded systems and high-level cloud/UI development.

**Location:** Chennai, India

**Team:** CHVAC Embedded Controls

  
  

**What you will do:**

* Lead the design, and development of full-stack solutions spanning embedded Linux controls, backend services, web UI, and cloud integration.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership in **C++ development on Linux and embedded Linux platforms** for HVAC controls software.
* Design and implement **communication protocol integrations** (e.g., **BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, REST**) between controllers, devices, and cloud systems.
* Develop **front-end development** of responsive, intuitive user interfaces using **React JS**.
* Architect and deploy cloud-based services and integrations on AWS, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability.
* Own technical planning, estimation, and delivery across the full software development lifecycle — from requirements through deployment and support.
* Drive quality, performance, and maintainability through sound design patterns, testing, and CI/CD practices.
  

  

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years of professional software development experience, including proven technical team leadership or management.
* Strong expertise in C++ development on Linux, including embedded Linux-based control systems.
* Hands-on experience with communication protocols (e.g., BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, REST/HTTP) for device and system integration.
* Solid front-end development skills with React JS and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud services and cloud-native application development and deployment.
* Demonstrated ability to architect end-to-end full-stack solutions across embedded, backend, UI, and cloud layers.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and managing engineering teams through the full software development lifecycle.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Software Engineer II - Backend Leaning FullStack @ Rippling (KA, IN)
job.description:
**About Rippling**

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, **Rippling has raised $1.85B+** from the world’s top investors—including **Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, Bedrock****, GIC, Elad Gil and Goldman Sachs**—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the team**
------------------

The App Components Team is a forward-thinking, platform-focused product engineering team dedicated to crafting the cohesive, high-performing building blocks that define Rippling’s "Enterprise Studio" experience.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a **Software Engineer II (Backend / Full Stack)** on this team you will be responsible to build and scale the systems that power these components. While your primary focus will be on the backend, this is a truly full-stack role. You will help design the distributed systems that power our platform and also contribute to React and React Native code to deliver polished end-to-end product experiences.

You will be responsible for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data models, while partnering closely with product and design to ensure the underlying complexity is translated into seamless, high-performance user experiences.

**What you will do**

* Design and implement scalable backend services using Python and Golang to support complex enterprise data modeling and product use cases.
* Contribute to systems that operate at scale, with exposure to distributed systems challenges and technologies such as Kafka, Flink, and AWS.
* While your strength lies in backend engineering, you will also contribute to the frontend codebase. You will write high-quality React and React Native code to ship end-to-end features and help deliver intuitive, performant UI components.
* Take ownership of meaningful product initiatives from early problem definition through implementation. You will help shape technical designs for new "App Studio" capabilities and deliver robust solutions.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, participate in thoughtful code reviews, and contribute to strong engineering standards across backend and frontend systems.
* Work closely with Product, Design, and other engineers to break down complex user problems and build components that are technically strong and practically useful for teams building on top of them.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong experience building production systems
* Proficiency in building scalable backend services. Experience with Python, Django, Golang, MongoDB, and AWS is highly preferred.
* Comfortable in writing and shipping production code in React and React Native. You should understand component lifecycles, state management, and mobile constraints well enough to build and iterate on UI for the systems you own.
* Ability to design scalable, reliable systems and reason through trade-offs such as consistency, performance, and fault tolerance.
* Experience building reusable systems, frameworks, or developer-facing components is a plus. You should be excited by building flexible foundations that can support multiple product use cases over time.
* A track record of independently driving projects, navigating ambiguity, and delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
